import { loadCSSLayer, setupImportMap } from "@/utils.ts"; import CERegistry from "/src/index"; import catalog from "@/components/catalog.js"; loadCSSLayer("/shared.css", "ds"); loadCSSLayer("https://nordcdn.net/ds/css/4.2.0/nord.min.css", "ds"); setupImportMap(); const loaders = { a: async () => { return await import(/* @vite-ignore */ `./a.js`); }, b: async () => { return await import(/* @vite-ignore */ `./b.js`); }, }; const registry = new CERegistry({ catalog: catalog, defaultDirective: "visible", live: true, }); function registerComponents(event) { const loader = loaders[event.target.getAttribute("loader")]; if (!loader) { throw new Error("Invalid loader"); } console.info(("registerComponents: registering component with loader", loader)); registry.catalog = { "ab-component": loader }; registry.discover(); } document.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", registerComponents));
